ratio_nontemporal_over_plain.note: derived, not measured: host_nontemporal divided by host, each the best over the worker sweep. This is what the A3a pre registration selected on as registered, and the amendment of 2026-09-06 no longer does, because the two bests need not come from the same worker count; it is kept so the registered figure stays visible. The statistic that decides is traffic_model in the session manifest. Thresholds either way: above 1.20 charges read for ownership, below 1.10 does not, between is unresolved

ratio_plain_over_nontemporal.note: derived, not measured: the reciprocal, recorded so the rule cannot be read in the wrong direction. Above 0.909 charges nothing, below 0.833 charges read for ownership

host_plain_at_32_bytes.note: derived, not measured: host times 32 over 24, the plain triad recounted with the read for ownership its own store pays and its declared figure does not charge. No memory speed is recorded anywhere in this repository, so this number is not corroborated against a theoretical peak
